    # Assign the reviewer 'primer' by clicking the 'Unassigned' button
    unassigned_button = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("button", name="Unassigned")

    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    
    # Select 'primer' from the dropdown (assuming it appears as a listitem or option)
    try:
        primer_option = page.get_by_role("listitem", name="primer", exact=False)
        await primer_option.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    except Exception as e:
        # If 'primer' not found, try to search or use a different selector
        print("Reviewer 'primer' not found in dropdown; attempting to assign via text input.")

            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # Look for the 'Submit merge request' button
